notes: Read all 455 source lines with numbered output before editing. The default-exported SharedDrivePage, the ExpiredShareView/normalizeSharedDriveData helpers, every state name (token/rawData/isLoading/error/data/unitPrefs/formatDistance/formatSpeed/distancePref/speedPref/elevPref/effPref/mapPoints/center/startPos/endPos/elevationData/speedData/drive), the public API path (GET /share/{token} via useSharedDrive), the SI unit handling, and all i18n keys are preserved verbatim.
L1 import {useMemo} -> React + {useCallback, useMemo}: useMemo preserved for data/mapPoints/center/elevationData/speedData; useCallback backs the inlined useTranslation + useUnits formatters.
L2 react-router-dom useParams<{token}>() -> an optional `token` page prop (SharedDrivePageProps); token still drives useSharedDrive(token ?? '') exactly as the source (L151/L153). RN has no router.

L3 react-i18next useTranslation -> inlined native useTranslation(): t(key, fallback?, vars?) returns the English fallback (or key) with {{var}} interpolation; the parity bundle ships no i18n runtime, every key preserved at the call site. ExpiredShareView calls useTranslation() internally exactly like the source (L121).

L4-6 lucide-react {MapPin, Clock, Zap, Battery, Mountain, Gauge, TrendingUp} -> native SemanticIcon registry glyphs: MapPin->'mapPinned', Clock->'clock', Zap->'bolt', Battery->'battery', Mountain->'map', Gauge->'speedCircle', TrendingUp->'trendUp' (matching the ProjectedRangePage FACTOR_ICONS precedent: elevation->'map'//Mountain, driving_style->'speedCircle'//Gauge). No SVG/DOM icon library is imported.

L7 GlassPanel from @/components/ui -> the ported native ../../../../components/ui/GlassPanel (used for the vehicle badge, stat cards, map-info panel, and no-data fallback). L8 Grid from @/components/layout -> an inlined flex-wrap 2-up grid (styles.statsGrid + StatCard flexBasis 47%) covering the cols={{default:2, md:4}} intent. L9 StatCard from @/components/data-display -> an inlined native StatCard (label/value/icon only — the props these call sites use): a glass card with a muted label + tinted SemanticIcon header and a bold value (web text-2xl font-bold -> variant=title weight=bold).

L10 Spinner, EmptyState from @/components/feedback -> Spinner becomes a centered <ActivityIndicator color={colors.accent} size=large> (web L209-215); EmptyState is the ported native ../../../components/feedback/EmptyState (icon + message), preserving the no-action comment and share.noMapData key (L431-433).

L11-16 Recharts {ChartContainer, ChartGradient, chartGrid, axisTick, AreaChart, Area, LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, AREA_DEFAULTS} -> the already-ported native ../../../components/charts {ChartContainer, AreaChartWrapper}. The two charts collapse onto ChartContainer (title/ariaLabel/height preserved) + AreaChartWrapper (data/xKey/series/height + xFormatter/yFormatter). The web XAxis tickFormatter `${Math.round(v)} ${distancePref}` -> xFormatter; the YAxis tickFormatter -> yFormatter; the <ChartGradient>/<CartesianGrid {...chartGrid}>/<Tooltip contentStyle> (DOM/SVG + hover, no native analog) collapse into the wrapper's native area layers + non-interactive latest-value summary; the AREA_DEFAULTS/axisTick spreads are styling-only and dropped.

LatLngExpression -> mapPoints typed [number,number][].

L33 SharedDriveData/SharedDriveDataV1 types imported from the same ported hook module (exported there).
